summary: Amtech Systems Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on June 1, 2026, for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of common stock at a yet-undisclosed price. The stock trades on Nasdaq under ASYS; the last sale on May 29 was $21.27. Titan Partners Group LLC is the sole underwriter. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing S-3 shelf registration, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic-review components, and no managerial changes or restructuring events. The offering is standard dilution-raising and warrants no special-situation classification.
